paite: Huai hun chiang in Mikael, heutu thupi na mite tapate vengbittu ahong dingkhe ding hi. Leitung pianchil a kipan tu hun tanpha a om ngei nai lou, mangbat hun ahong tung ding hi, huai hun chiang in laibu sung a gelh a om a, muhkhiak a om na mite hutkhiak in a-om ding uh.
heading: Hun Tawp Thugente
english: “At that time Michael will stand up, the great prince who stands for the children of your people; and there will be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time. At that time your people will be delivered, everyone who is found written in the book.

paite: Huan alak ua mi tampi leitung a leivui a ihmute akhanglou ding ua, akhen tangtawn hinna tang ding in, akhen zumna leh tangtawn simmohna tang ding in.
english: Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

paite: Apilte vansin vakna bang in avak ding ua; mi tampi diktatna lam a heite tangtawn tangtawn in aksite bang in atang ding uhi.
english: Those who are wise will shine as the brightness of the expanse. Those who turn many to righteousness will shine as the stars forever and ever.

paite: Himahleh nang, Aw Daniel, hun tawp tan a ding in thute khakkhum bikbek inla, laibu bilh in; mi tampi avialtai ding ua, theihna apung ding.
english: But you, Daniel, shut up the words and seal the book, even to the time of the end. Many will run back and forth, and knowledge will be increased.”

paite: Huai lai in kei, Daniel in ka en a, ngai in, midang nih, lui gei hiai lam pang ah khat, lui gei lang lam pang ah khat adingh uhi.
english: Then I, Daniel, looked, and behold, two others stood, one on the river bank on this side, and the other on the river bank on that side.

paite: Huan khat in puanmalngat asilh a, luituite tung a ompa kiang ah, "Hiai thillamdangte tawpna ding bangchi a sawt hi ding ahia?" achi hi.
english: One said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, “How long will it be to the end of these wonders?”

paite: "Puanmalngat silh a, luituite tung a ompa'n van lam a akhut taklam leh akhut veilam liktou in, amah tangtawn a hingpa min a kichiam in hun khat, hunte leh hun kimkhat ahi ding achih ka zata hi; misiangthoute thilhihtheihna asuknen dimdem khit chiang un, hiai thil tengteng zoh ahi ding," chi in.
english: I heard the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand to heaven, and swore by him who lives forever that it will be for a time, times, and a half; and when they have finished breaking in pieces the power of the holy people, all these things will be finished.

paite: Huai ka za a, himahleh ka theisiam kei. Ke'n, "Aw ka Toupa, hiai thilte tawpna bang hi ding ahia?" ka chi hi.
english: I heard, but I didn’t understand. Then I said, “My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?”

paite: Ama'n, "Pai in, Daniel; thute khakkhum bikbek ahita ua, hun tawp matan a bilh bikbek ahita hi,” achi hi.
english: He said, “Go your way, Daniel; for the words are shut up and sealed until the time of the end.

paite: Mi tampi akihihsiangthou ding ua, angou ding ua, akibawlhoih ding uh; himahleh giloute agilou sem ding ua; giloute lak a kuamah in atheisiam kei ding uh; himahleh apilte'n atheisiam ding uh.
english: Many will purify themselves, and make themselves white, and be refined, but the wicked will do wickedly; and none of the wicked will understand, but those who are wise will understand.

paite: Huchi in halmang thillat gige lakmang a om a, hihgawptu kihhuai tunkhiak a hong om ding hun a kipan, ni sangkhat zanih-le-sawmkua a-om ding hi.
english: “From the time that the continual burnt offering is taken away and the abomination that makes desolate set up, there will be one thousand two hundred ninety days.

paite: Ni sangkhat zathum sawmthum-le-nga ngak a, huai a hong paite'n nuam asa uhi.
english: Blessed is he who waits, and comes to the one thousand three hundred thirty-five days.

paite: Himahleh atawp matan nang zaw pai in; na khawl ding a, nang a dia piakna mun ah nite beina ah na goutan sang ding in na thoukhe ding hi.
english: “But go your way until the end; for you will rest, and will stand in your inheritance at the end of the days.”
